RagShortTexts: The Margraves of Baden guarded Upper Rhine trade and Black Forest valleys beneath their.

Variants.Content: Governing the western slopes of the Black Forest, Rudolf I of Baden maintained strategic mastery over the Upper Rhine highway. Retaining their ancient Zähringen pedigree, the margraves defended mountain passes and fertile Rhine vineyards from expansive neighbors.
Fortified cliff castles and rugged forest skirmishers made Baden an impenetrable bastion during interregnum chaos.
